# Synapse Automate

> Türkiye merkezli kurumsal AI otomasyonu, RevenueOS ve yapay zekâ odaklı ürün ekosistemi.

Canonical site: https://synapseautomate.github.io/
Contact: synapseautomate.ai@gmail.com | +90 552 202 98 50

## Primary commercial engine
- Müşteri Talebi ve Satış Takibi (RevenueOS): gelen potansiyel müşteri ön değerlendirmesi, randevu planlama, takip, müşteri takip sistemi and measurement.
- 72 Saatlik İlk Kurulum core: approved knowledge base, 30 FAQ, 8–12 intents/flows, potansiyel müşteri puanlama, randevu planlama/yetkili personele aktarım, 3 takip messages, potansiyel müşteri takip tablosu and 30 test cases.
- Home Services / Çatı ve Tadilat is one documented RevenueOS implementation pattern; sector coverage is not exclusive.

## Sector coverage
- Healthcare
- Finance & Banking
- E-Commerce
- Real Estate
- Legal Operations
- Manufacturing & Logistics
- Education
- Property Management
- Home Services / Çatı ve Tadilat

## Core services
- Yapay Zekâ Destekli Müşteri Asistanı & Customer Service
- Sales & Müşteri Adayı Kazanımı
- Accounting & Finance Automation
- HR & Recruitment
- Marketing, Content & SEO
- Legal & Compliance iş akışı support
- AI Training & Consulting
- kurum içi bilgiye dayalı yapay zekâ, custom AI and kalite testiuations
- AI Analiz & Optimization
- Process Mining
- Voice AI & Call Center
- Predictive Analytics

## Products and ecosystem
- RevenueOS — primary commercial engine
- Web ve Katalog Hazırlık Sistemi (AgentReady) — product architecture
- İçerik Üretim Sistemi (Creative) — product architecture
- Etkileşimli Teklif Sistemi (MagnetFlow) — product architecture
- Teklif ve İş Takip Sistemi (VELA) — product architecture
- TradeOps Lab — technical research/kalite testiuation lab, not a separate commercial brand
- Kilory — AI nutrition, activity, recipe, habit and social motivation application; investor presentation status: launch-ready
- Kinetra Studios — planned AI product studio
- Kinetra Group — planned umbrella combining product and kurumsal automation engines

## Trust principles
- Security > accuracy > evidence > usability > aesthetics.
- No fabricated case studies, clients, metrics, guarantees or public links.
- Unknown information remains unverified.
- Critical pricing, payment, contract and sensitive advice require insan onayı.
- Medical, legal and financial advice is not autonomously provided.
- Minimum data, approved sources, kullanıcı bağlılığı/deletion rules and controlled yetkili personele aktarım are required.
